factsChecked: The method is for a private user chat and returns True on success.
An empty draft shows Telegram's temporary Thinking placeholder.
Draft text is limited to 4096 characters and the draft ID must be non-zero.
The draft is a temporary preview; sendMessage persists the completed answer.

provedBehavior: An admitted private Telegram turn first submits one empty Thinking draft.
Only genuine model deltas from a tool-free final phase cross the internal NDJSON stream; post-hoc replay of a completed answer was removed.
Draft growth is append-only, coalesced and offered no more often than once per second.
A structured Telegram 429 retry_after pauses later draft attempts without delaying or duplicating the durable final answer.
The Living Core and its journal retain the complete canonical reply. Only the Telegram connector renders a maximum 4096-character channel version and recalculates its hash.

A group turn bypasses drafts. Failure of the initial placeholder falls back to one ordinary core request before any model request was started; failure of a later text draft lets the already-running stream finish.
The existing delivery claim still produces exactly one persistent sendMessage receipt. Drafts add no durable replay state.

negativeCases: hash-valid but whitespace-padded core final rejected
overlong core answer preserved upstream and ellipsized only for Telegram
429 retry_after suppresses another draft attempt while final delivery continues
